survey: Round glass plate of fruit on a wooden table, camera looking down at about 40-50 degrees. The table planks run diagonally, with seams that stay parallel and spread slightly toward the viewer, so the table reads as one flat surface. The plate's rim and inner well are ellipses of matching narrowness that fit the table's angle. The plate lies flat on the table and its shadow falls lower left on the same plane. A watermelon wedge stands on its rind at the back of the plate with the cut face toward the camera; its base sits inside the plate ellipse and its seed rows follow the wedge's face. An orange half stands upright at the back right with its cut face forward. An orange wedge lies on the plate at the front left, its cut face seen from above and in front. Green grapes form a mound in the centre, seen from above and in front. Strawberries and blueberries rest on the plate floor and are seen from above. The front strawberry's calyx looks slightly too straight-down, but that is mild stylization. Water droplets sit flat on the plate and the fruit. Every part shares one camera and rests on its surface at the angle that surface is drawn.
